name: Drowned
source:
Marcos wakes up in an abandoned basement with no memory of how he got there, only to discover that he’s trapped with someone from his past who constantly sends him mixed messages. 

His primary goal is to escape. As he navigates this strange space, a single question lingers in his mind: “Is it possible to trust anything? Can I even trust myself?

[From [url=https://drassz.itch.io/drowned]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
马科斯在一个废弃的地下室中醒来，不记得自己是如何到达那里的，却发现自己被困在了一个过去的人身边，这个人不断地向他发送混乱的信息。

他的首要目标是逃跑。当他在这个陌生的空间中航行时，一个问题萦绕在他的脑海中：“可以相信任何东西吗？我什至可以相信自己吗？”

[来自[url=https://drassz.itch.io/drowned]Itch.io[/url]]
